title: FHIR IG AST: one branch per IG package, the input the IG site is built from
location: cat/fhir-harness/fhir-ast/<package id>, on the IG repository's own origin

keyRecipe.expression: the sha256 `ig-ast.ts digest` computes over the CONTENT of the IG's inputs (sushi-config.yaml, ig.ini, input/), recorded as inputs.inputDigest in output-ast/manifest.json; with the Publisher toolchain the manifest records

derivedInputs: the content of the IG's inputs as `ig-ast.ts digest` reads them (tree-scoped, never commit-scoped: a merge, rebase or README-only commit leaves the key alone), plus the Publisher toolchain the manifest records; the branch name is keyed by the IG's package id, never by a hand list of files
holds: the IG Publisher's AST export (output-ast/: manifest.json and one JSON file per resource) and the Publisher's terminology cache (input-cache/txcache/)
producer: fhir-harness ig-ast-refresh.yml, step 'Seed the AST cache' (`ig-cache.sh seed --ig-root . --push`) on the Java runner, after a full IG Publisher build with the AST exporter; that dispatch is this cache's own save path (process Process_IgAstCache, Task_Export then Task_Seed)
consumers: the IG site build (`ig-repo-site.ts` via stage-local, Process_IgAstCache Task_Restore then Task_BuildSite)
ig-ast-refresh.yml's own restore, which skips the Publisher build when the restored AST is valid
build-ig-indexes and stage-ast-sites, which list the branches but restore only for an IG they build

stateInputs.how: not yet derived from a recorded read set; the producer may read state:mount graphs

refresh.how: over a STALE cache, ig-ast-refresh.yml runs IncrementalBuildCli (the AST delta, skill ig-ast-delta) on the Java runner and keeps its result only when `validity` passes; a failed or invalid delta, a release, or `force` builds in full

savePolicy: default branch only: seeded when the built commit is an ancestor of the default branch's tip and sushi-config.yaml, ig.ini and input/ are the same at both (Process_IgAstCache GW_Seedable); any other ref keeps its AST as a run artifact and leaves the cache alone
verify: `ig-cache.sh verify` runs `ig-ast.ts validity`: the digest of the IG's inputs now (or as committed at `--at <rev>`) against the manifest's inputs.inputDigest. Exit 0 valid, 1 stale-inputs (naming the input), 2 cannot-tell; anything but valid is a miss, so a bad entry costs a rebuild and is never built from
uses: scripts/ig-cache.sh:413 cmd_verify (validity, then the cached-step line)
.github/workflows/ig-ast-refresh.yml:163-168 restore, validity and the cached-step line
.github/workflows/ig-ast-refresh.yml:284 warm: the line after a valid incremental build
notes: Restored only by steps that build or render an IG (owner, 2026-11-05: "not all rendering/CI/merge processes need all caches. be optimal"): never by a test shard, a gate or a merge job. Process_IgAstCache is this cache's component process; Process_Cache (cat-harness) draws it as a task in its own lane, since a lower layer cannot call into this one: Task_Restore and GW_Valid are its verify, Task_Seed its save. The old `cat-fhir-ast/` and `fhir-ast/` branch names are retired (bean oycs), so they are not read. Every restore and refresh prints one line in cached-step's format: `**cached-step `ig-ast`: hit|warm|miss** (exact) — <why>. Key `<input digest>`.`
